title: Story premise EDU036: The Museum of Useful Mistakes
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (learning/study). Hook: Which tiny step broke the whole solution? Takeaway/theme: Recording the specific error can make the next check more targeted.
description: A learner wants to stop repeating one algebra slip, but an answer-only notebook hides where it begins. An error exhibit pairs the mistaken step, its cause, and a corrected counterexample.
